quality_grader_1_items.notes: Only runtime artifacts plus pom.xml are in the source (tree ends truncated). Design 3: LoginTest and CheckoutTest are separate and named, but the full login sequence is repeated in checkout, no page-object types are present, and checkout is one long method. Checkout JSON fields firstName, lastName, and postalCode are never typed, yet the run still reaches checkout-step-two. SHAFT idioms 13: shaft-bom/shaft-engine 10.4.20261112, AspectJ surefire agent, TestNGListener, propertiesFolderPath, and SHAFT JSON load of testDataFiles/sauceDemo.json; actions are ReportManager navigate/type/click/assert with openBrowser/closeBrowser, not raw Selenium. Several steps use Javascript click. Robustness 8: locators are ids and data-test (logged as xpath), no sleeps, SHAFT pageLoad 30s and assertion waits, no retries; JS click is used for add-to-cart, cart, checkout, continue, and finish. Test data 5: baseURL and browser settings live in custom properties; credentials, paths, and copy live in sauceDemo.json (public demo password). Readability 4: method names are clear; pom has no PMD or Checkstyle, and the checkout scenario is a single long test. Hygiene 0: no README or .gitignore; allure-report, allure-results, and eight performanceReport JSON files are generated junk.
